annotations.title: A price for a specific case, computed from the company's own price list

description: Computes an exact price for a specific case (quantities, options, period) from the price list a company has itself deposited with Isoligne, and returns the calculation line by line with its source and date. Only companies that have deposited a price list are covered, which in practice means Isoligne clients; this is unrelated to the published Index and rankings. Example: entreprise = example.com, question = "how much for 800 units in 6 variants per month?". A missing quantity is never guessed: the answer says which one to provide.

entreprise.description: the company's domain (e.g. example.com) or name

question.description: the price question, with quantities, in any language
